Not a human editorial review and not a completed transaction. Applies to requests to central public authorities through RTI Online; state public authorities follow their own RTI rules. The linked organization identifies the existing website operator; the responsible department is listed separately. Unknown fields stay null.

eligibility.text: Indian citizens requesting information from covered Government of India ministries/departments.

conditionalDocuments.text: If you are below the poverty line: a copy of the BPL certificate issued by the appropriate government, attached with the application, to be exempt from the fee.

procedure.text: Do not upload an Aadhaar card, PAN card or any other personal identification. The only exception is a BPL card when you claim the fee exemption.

If you have paid but no registration number appears, wait 24–48 working hours while the payment is reconciled, and do not pay again. If it has still not appeared, email the RTI Online helpdesk (helprtionline-dopt[at]nic[dot]in) with the transaction details.

fees.text: ₹10 per request (Right to Information Rules, 2012, rule 3). RTI Online accepts internet banking, Mastercard or Visa credit and debit cards, UPI and RuPay cards. Applicants below the poverty line pay no fee if they attach a copy of their BPL certificate (rule 5).
